about: Ground looks (custom geometry plan, stage M6): each one of the game's plain pieces whose material a ground shape is drawn in (tools/bake/ground.py builds the shape; the Build copies the piece and puts the shape's mesh in it). A shape's numbers name their look (`look`; left out, the first). `repeat` is the material's texture repeat in world units on the donor's top (its UVs against its positions); `thickness` a patch's, under the ground it lies on.

looks.name: Asphalt
looks.words: dark street asphalt, as the bar's parking lot
